items.stem: Which TWO are ALM best practices in Power Platform? (Select TWO)

options.text: Use source control as the source of truth for components
options.rationale: Correct: source control should be the source of truth for storing and collaborating on components.

options.text: Use environment variables so configuration can change per environment
options.rationale: Correct: environment variables separate parameters from objects so values change across environments.

options.text: Develop and edit solutions directly in production
options.rationale: Direct production development bypasses healthy ALM and risks instability.
Pipelines require stages in order; test precedes production.

items.explanation: Correct: source control should be the source of truth for storing and collaborating on components.
